issues.explanation: Chapter 95 repeats the孟达/新城 campaign already completed in adapted Chapter 94, including司马懿得知反情、急赴新城 and孟达被杀. The source Chapter 95 begins after these events and only reports their outcome before moving to街亭, so the repetition creates a backward-moving, confusing timeline at the handoff.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the repeated新城 summary from Chapter 95. Begin with曹叡命司马懿、张郃出兵 and the援军 to曹真, then have孔明 receive the report that孟达已死 and司马懿已出关, leading directly to the街亭 assignment.
